messages:
Ashley: quick mid-q check — bridging product + eng on OKR milestone statuses. TL;DR: 2 shipped, 1 slipped, 2 at risk. See below for owners/asks.

Vikram: Ship A (embedding cache) is live on dedicated. Perf looks good; 95p latency down 18%. :thumbsup:

Marta: Ship B (model routing rules) rolled out to canary, found routing edge case when sequence > 2048, investigating. Assigned to Lee.

Lee: looking now. Repro steps? paste logs:
```
WARN: route-fallback hit for model-2 seq=2050
```

Lee: ETA fix + tests by EOD tomorrow. Will also open CR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-fix

Jordan: QA: regression tests for chatflows passed on staging except a flaky embed-case. Logging ticket: #3456

SRE-bot: deploy successful for Ship A at 2026-03-16T10:22Z (build 0.3.12). No incidents.

Marta: Ship C (billing metrics) slipped — waiting on infra quota increase from cloud. Contacted finance + infra.

Vikram: Dependency: infra quota (ticket INF-1122). If quota approved this week we can recover in 2 sprints, else slip to next quarter.

Ashley: asks:
- Marta, confirm owner for routing fix (assign Lee?)
- Vikram, prioritize quota escalation
- Jordan, list failing test cases in ticket

Marta: confirmed, Lee owner. I'll update OKR doc.

Lee: CR opened, pinging reviewers @Vikram @Ashley. pls +1 if you can review before EOD.

Vikram: will review by lunch. :eyes:

Ashley: thanks all. Next steps: consolidate into the milestone board by EOD, I'll send a short update to execs tomorrow.

Jordan: QA will re-run failing case after Lee's fix, will post results here.

Ashley: :thumbsup:
